subject: Helix AI — regional onramp activation triggers & runbook
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@helix.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity needs for Q4 launch (US/EU/APAC)

Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We9re proceeding toward a staged public launch in Q4 and need Redwood to support dedicated pools for our customer-facing models across US, EU, and APAC. High level requests:

- Start with a 3-month burst/transition to dedicated during launch week, then settle into a sustained reserved tranche.
- Target SLOs: p95 <= 250ms (US/EU), p95 <= 300ms (APAC edge).
- Data residency: EU inference must be isolated to the Frankfurt pool (we have regulatory reviewers).
- Model profile: two concurrent models (chat-medium ~6B token context, chat-large ~13B context), with expected 120M tokens/day global during launch week.

I attached our traffic forecast and a short run of expected peak QPS by region. Can your team confirm what activation triggers you9d need, and a playbook for fast activation + rollback? Also include any PO/SOW expectations so procurement can prepare.

Appreciate it — Sylvia

Attachments: helix_traffic_forecast.csv

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@helix.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs for Q4 launch (US/EU/APAC)

Sylvia —

Thanks for the forecast and the clear SLO targets. Looping in Karthik (capacity/ops) and Laura (compliance/procurement) so we can scope a concrete activation runbook and SOW.

Immediate asks from our side to size deterministically:
- Per-region expected peak QPS and average session length (CSV helps).
- % of requests that will use chat-large vs chat-medium.
- Acceptable cost bracket / preferred tranche length (3m, 6m, 12m).
- Any hard isolation constraints (e.g., physical host-level encryption/HSM).

We9ll propose: (1) a fast burst reservation for launch week (warm nodes + preloaded KV caches), (2) a sustained reserved pool per region sized to expected steady-state, and (3) automated rollback lanes if latency/regression surfaces.

Karthik — can you draft activation triggers (metrics + lead times) and a short runbook we can share with Helix this week? Laura, anything procurement needs flagged up-front for EU data residency?

Thanks — Rishi

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, Sylvia Park <sylvia@helix.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs for Q4 launch (US/EU/APAC)

Sylvia / team —

Attached is a concise activation runbook (region_onramp_runbook_v2.pdf) and a proposed tranche plan below. I kept the language action-oriented so ops can execute quickly. High-level proposal:

1) Launch Week (burst, T0) — 2-week window for burst prep, 1-week activation
   - US pool: provision 24 GPUs (A100 class equivalent), prewarm with chat-large weights and KV cache priming; expected p95 margin = 190-230ms.
   - EU pool (Frankfurt, isolated): provision 16 GPUs, strict tenancy + disk encryption, prewarm identical to US.
   - APAC pool (Singapore edge): provision 12 GPUs with slightly smaller batch sizes (network variance), target p95 260-300ms.

2) Sustained tranche (T1) — post-launch steady state (3-6 months)
   - US: scale down to 12 GPUs reserved, allow burst increases via on-demand lanes.
   - EU: 10 GPUs reserved (isolated), maintain KMS/HSM key reference.
   - APAC: 8 GPUs reserved, keep cross-region failover to US if critical.

Activation triggers (metrics & lead times):
- Rolling 5m sustained p95 > target + 15% traffic spike -> start warm-up within 30m.
- 20% QoE degradation (user error rates, model fallback) -> escalate and hold burst for 2h.
- HubSpot deal stage to "Committed — PO Issued" -> start procurement provisioning workflow (lead ~7 business days).

Operational notes:
- Prewarm steps (30-90 minutes): model load, KV priming, smoke test with synthetic prompts.
- Cache sync across pools only for non-sensitive telemetry; EU pool must not export raw logs outside region.
- Rollback: automatic traffic shift to on-host fallback variants; if rollback fails, traffic reroute to hosted API with blue/green header flags.

I9ve included a short checklist in the PDF. Sylvia, if those GPU counts look off, tell us the regional peak QPS per model and I can re-run more accurate per-token costing.

Attachments: region_onramp_runbook_v2.pdf

— Karthik

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia@helix.ai>, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs for Q4 launch (US/EU/APAC)

Adding a procurement/compliance view. A few items Helix needs to confirm before we can lock the EU isolated pool:

- PO cadence: Are you planning a single PO for the launch burst + sustained tranche, or separate POs? We recommend separate documents (burst SOW + sustained SOW) to allow faster procurement for the burst.
- EU data processing addendum and SCCs are required; we will provide a redline template but we need confirmation on logging/retention windows (default is 90 days for logs; Helix can request shorter).
- HSM/KMS integration: if you require customer-managed keys in EU, we9ll need a lead time of ~10 business days to enable with the node provisioning.
- Billing model: burst usage will be charged at on-demand premium; sustained reserves will be invoiced monthly against committed usage.

I9ll attach our recommended contract redlines for Helix to review (helix_contract_terms_redlines.docx). If Helix can confirm PO approach and KMS posture by end of week, procurement can prioritize EU isolation for the requested launch week.

— Laura

From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@helix.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity needs for Q4 launch (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks team — this is helpful and actionable. Quick answers:

- We9ll do separate POs: (1) launch burst (2) 6-month sustained tranche. Procurement will upload the burst PO to DocuSign by next Wednesday.
- KMS: Helix prefers customer-managed keys in EU; please start the 10 business day enablement.
- Traffic split: attached CSV has per-region peak QPS and model mix (60% chat-medium, 40% chat-large during launch).
- Logs: we can accept 30-day retention for operational logs; analytics traces can be exported off-site after aggregated anonymization.

Please proceed with runbook steps and let us know an estimated activation-ready date based on the PO timing. We9re excited to move forward.

Sylvia

Attachments: helix_traffic_forecast.csv
